value.rationale: Sharp design feasibility for a canonical infinite-variance-capable heavy-tailed stationary law in a harmonic trap is a natural nonequilibrium inverse problem. The result gives a nontrivial two-parameter family-wide rate/width threshold, a unique universal minimal reset budget, and a geometric origin-to-shell zero-set transition including critical quartic contact. The exponent-independent optimal zero radius distinguishes it from generic inverse-source identities and supplies a concrete structural diagnostic. It does not claim an energy-cost optimum or experimental accuracy.
